Chapter 1115: Earthquake-level Commotion in the Entire Immortal Realms
Translator: Lordbluefire  Editor: Lordbluefire
The Ever&green Immortal Emperor <> s<tood high up in the air. <i> The light radiating from him illuminated the sky and at this moment, everyone in the boundlessly vast empire were all staring at him, feeling awe in their hearts.
